name: Path-scoped rules for owned text
summary: Putting owned guidance in rules with paths: frontmatter to keep it out of the always-loaded budget. Held: field reports disagree on whether such rules load at session start, and they never load when Write creates the matching file or in an additional directory. Owned text in such a rule counts as always loaded (C-3).

evidence.source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/16299 (Path-scoped rules in .claude/rules/ load into context globally regardless of paths: frontmatter)
evidence.setting: Open field report; a 2.1.300 Windows comment there found the rule body deferred and only an @ import inside the rule loaded at start
evidence.effect: Path-scoped rules load at session start, so they keep nothing out of the always-loaded budget

evidence.source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/96361 (Path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md never load when Write creates a new file)
evidence.effect: The rule never loads when Write creates the matching file

evidence.source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/106095 (Path-scoped rules in an additional directory never load)
evidence.effect: Rules in an additional directory never load

revisit: a sentinel test on the installed version: the rule is absent at session start and present after reading, editing and creating a matching file
maintenance: Native Claude Code feature; re-run the sentinel test on new versions.
